feature_name: Metadata caching for BigLake tables on Amazon S3
summary: Metadata caching is available for BigLake tables that reference Amazon S3 data to improve query performance.
extended_definition: Metadata caching is available for BigLake tables that reference Amazon S3 data to improve query performance.

supporting_pages.title: "Introduction to BigLake external tables \_|\_ BigQuery \_|\_ Google Cloud\
evidence_snippets: The following types of BigLake tables support metadata caching: Amazon S3 BigLake tables Cloud Storage BigLake tables BigQuery uses CMETA as a distributed metadata system to handle large tables efficiently.
Using customer-managed encryption keys (CMEK) with cached metadata is not supported for BigLake tables that reference Amazon S3 or Blob Storage data.
For more information on setting metadata caching options, see Create Amazon S3 BigLake tables or Create Cloud Storage BigLake tables .
